κακῶς, the adverb, filed inside κακός, as καλῶς is inside καλός: ill, evil.

reading: [[gods|gods, the gods, goddesses|θεός]] not [[you will speak ill of|you will speak ill of / revile / abuse|κακολογέω]] and [[rulers|rulers / commanders / chiefs / captains, chief magistrates at Athens|ἄρχων]] [[of the people|of the people, of the people / men, of the soldiers, of the land-army, of the common men, of the folk, of the Jews, of the Christians|λαός]] of you not [[ill|ill, bad, mean / ugly, ill-born / mean / ignoble, craven / cowardly / base, worthless / sorry / poor, bad / evil / wicked, bad / evil / baneful, bad / unlucky, evil / abusive|κακῶς]] [[you will say|you will say / speak, you will say / declare, you will say something of, you will call by name, you will tell, you will boast of / tell of, you will recite|λέγω]]. —

greek: ἀπαρχὰς ἅλωνος καὶ ληνοῦ σου οὐ καθυστερήσεις· τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν υἱῶν σου δώσεις ἐμοί.
hint: First-fruits of grain and wine are not to be held back, and the firstborn sons belong to the lord.

notes.text: First-fruits of threshing-floor and vat: the Hebrew has mĕlēʾātĕkā wĕdimʿăkā, your fullness and your juice.
πρωτότοκος, first-born, one translation, plain text.

reading: [[beginnings of a sacrifice|beginnings of a sacrifice / primal offerings, firstlings, first-fruits|ἀπαρχή]] [[of a threshing-floor|of a threshing-floor, of disk|ἅλων]] and [[of a tub|of a tub, of a wine-vat, of a trough|ληνός]] of you not [[you will come far behind|you will come far behind, you will be behind-hand|καθυστερέω]]; the first-born of the sons of you [[you will give|you will give, you will grant, you will provide, you will offer to the gods, you will tender, you will give over / deliver up, you will pardon, you will forgive, you will remit, you will grant / allow / bring about that, you will give yourself up / devote yourself|δίδωμι]] to me.

greek: οὕτως ποιήσεις τὸν μόσχον σου καὶ τὸ πρόβατόν σου καὶ τὸ ὑποζύγιόν σου· ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἔσται ὑπὸ τὴν μητέρα, τῇ δὲ ὀγδόῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἀποδώσεις μοι αὐτό. —
hint: Firstborn calves, sheep and beasts of burden stay seven days with the mother and are given on the eighth.

notes.text: The calf, the sheep, the beast of burden: the Hebrew has lĕšōrĕkā lĕṣōʾnekā, your ox and your flock.
ὄγδοος, eighth, one translation, plain text.

reading: [[in this way|in this way / manner / so / thus, so, even so / just so, so much, to such a pitch, so / so much / so very, so / merely so / simply, off-hand / at once|οὕτως]] [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will make / produce / create, you will compose / write, you will make / represent in poetry, you will describe in verse, you will put into verse, you will bring to pass / bring about / cause, you will hold, you will act, you will work / operate|ποιέω]] [[the calf|the calf, the young bull, the heifer / young cow, the boy / girl / maid, the young animal|μόσχος]] of you and [[the thing that walks forward|the anything that walks forward, the cattle / flocks, the flocks and herds, the horses, the small cattle, the sheep|πρόβατον]] of you and [[the beast for the yoke|the beast for the yoke / beast of burden|ὑποζύγιον]] of you; seven [[days|days, states / times of life|ἡμέρα]] will be [[towards and under|towards / under, under / into, under / before, under, in subjection, towards, about, about the time, to a certain degree / in some measure|ὑπό + accusative]] [[the mother|the mother, the dam, the source|μήτηρ]], [[but|but, while / whereas / on the other hand, then / yet, at, I say / now / so then|δέ]], to the eighth [[to day|to day, to a state / time of life|ἡμέρα]] [[you will give up|you will give up / give back / restore / return, you will render what is due / pay, you will return / render / yield, you will yield fruit, you will suffer / allow, you will render, you will deliver over / give up / deliver, you will render / give in, you will increase|ἀποδίδωμι]] to me it. —

greek: καὶ ἄνδρες ἅγιοι ἔσεσθέ μοι. καὶ κρέας θηριάλωτον οὐκ ἔδεσθε, τῷ κυνὶ ἀπορρίψατε αὐτό.
hint: Israel is to be holy; meat torn by wild beasts is not eaten but thrown to the dogs.

notes.text: ἀπορρίπτω, to throw away, the aorist imperative; its to shoot forth bold, keen words is restored whole.
To the dog, singular, for the Hebrew lakkeleb.

reading: and [[men|men, men in the prime of life, men indeed|ἀνήρ]] [[devoted to the gods|devoted to the gods / sacred / holy, holy / pure|ἅγιος]] you will be to me. and [[flesh|flesh / meat / a piece of meat, dressed meat / meat / flesh, a body / person|κρέας]] caught by wild beasts not [[you will eat|you will eat, you will eat of, you will devour, you will vex, you will bite|ἐσθίω]], [[to the dog|to the dog / bitch, to the hounds, to the shamelessness / audacity, to the rashness / recklessness, to the sea-dog, to the dog-star, to the dog of Orion|κύων]] [[throw away|throw away / put away, cast forth, disown / renounce, throw aside / set at naught, shoot forth bold / keen words, let fall|ἀπορρίπτω]] it.
